title: Habit Tracker Designer
prompt: Help design habit tracking systems with clear metrics, milestones, and accountability mechanisms. Suggest strategies for building and maintaining positive habits.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Build a sustainable habit tracker workflow for weekly planning, execution, and review
Reduce context-switching in habit tracker routines through prioritization and time allocation rules
Track habit tracker progress with simple metrics and corrective actions for missed targets
success_criteria: Workflow is simple, repeatable, and resistant to common interruptions
Priorities, deadlines, and review cadence are clearly defined
Habit tracker system improves consistency and completion rate
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
